description: The bars the golden vectors are pinned over (EvaluationGoldenVectorTests). Each bar is [minutes after start, open, high, low, close, volume]; a minute that is absent is a gap and nothing is filled in. Written once and never regenerated: a golden series is only a tripwire if its input cannot move either.

series.name: trend-utc
series.note: Monday 5 January 2026 from 00:00Z: a slow rise under three waves (120, 31 and 9 minutes), two flat stretches (minutes 60-71 at 102.00 before a fall, 200-211 at 96.00 before a rise), three bars that open through the previous close (minutes 37, 151, 263) and three gaps with no bar at all (101-104, 177, 240-249).

series.name: new-york-two-days
series.note: Monday 6 and Tuesday 7 July 2026, 09:00-13:59 New York (EDT, UTC-4) each day: Monday breaks up out of its opening range and falls back through it after 12:30; Tuesday breaks down, recovers above the range and drops late. The night between is a gap, Tuesday has a three-minute gap (14:47Z-14:49Z), and two bars open through the previous close.

series.name: london-dst
series.note: Saturday 28 March 2026 23:00Z to Sunday 29 March 03:59Z, across the EU change to summer time at 01:00Z (London 00:59 GMT is followed by 02:00 BST): two waves (40 and 11 minutes) on a slight rise, one bar opening through the previous close.
